summary: Anavex Life Sciences Corp. filed an 8-K solely to announce the date (September 24, 2026) and record date (July 31, 2026) for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, along with revised deadlines for stockholder proposals and nominations under Rule 14a-5(f). No special situation, transaction, or corporate action is involved. This is a routine administrative disclosure of meeting logistics and rule deadlines, not a triggering event under the special-situations framework.
